description: Hand-verified audit of Songkick single-DJ events (2026-10-19). Stratified sample of 110 from 2341 live events; founderCases are outside the sample and are not counted.
method: Live events read from the anon REST API (date >= 2026-10-19). Signals computed from the whole future event list. Verdicts from web search (WebSearch) on the event, venue and artist. verdict: correct = the electronic act is the one listed; namesake = evidence the listing is another act or not this DJ; unknown = no evidence either way (excluded from precision).
